exact_statement: For any finite Boolean sign F(A,B) under independent interior product biases, coherent averaging of physical restrictions satisfies E_pureB_ge2(F)<=E_A E_ge2(F(x,B))+3 sum_{U nonempty,|T|>=2}P_F(U,T), in natural corrected entropy with v_S=prod 4q_i(1-q_i). For every finite real-weight threshold, orient signed weights, remove zero/deterministic coordinates, and partition its remaining coordinates into positive equal-weight groups G_j. With r(S) the number of occupied groups, D_j=sum_{S:S intersects G_j}(|S intersects G_j|-1)P(S), R=sum_{S nonempty}(r(S)-1)P(S), and c=460+80 ln 2, the exact ledger is Delta=sum_j D_j+R and the sum E_pure_ge2 over sets wholly in one group with degree>=2 is at most c sum_j D_j+6R<=c Delta, using the all-bias symmetric-threshold baseline. For two groups R=M=sum_mixed P. No absolute mixed entropy payment is asserted. Actual unequal-weight fair thresholds with m weights 2, m weights 1 and threshold 3m are conjunction signs, with E_mixed/M=2(2m-1)ln2, disproving any constant M-only mixed payment. For M>0 the product of the normalized mixed spectral marginals is a complete reference and E_mixed=E_A_m+E_B_m+M ln M-M TC_spec exactly, where TC_spec is spectral, not conditional physical-input TC. Arbitrary weighted FEI+ and full FEI remain open.

exact_statement: For every actual finite Boolean sign on two disjoint physical coordinate groups under an interior product law, let P(U,T) be its squared normalized product Fourier coefficients on the mixed sector U,T nonempty, M=sum P, a(U)=sum_T P, b(T)=sum_U P, d=|U|+|T|, and Delta_m=sum(d-1)P. When M>0, Q0=a b/M^2 and Qd=(d-1)a b/(M Delta_m) are complete normalized mixed references; Rd=(d-1)P/Delta_m has Rd/Qd=(P/M)/Q0 pointwise on positive actual atoms, but the two KL averages need not agree. Exactly E_mix/Delta_m=E_Rd[ln(v_U v_T/P)/(d-1)] and M TC_spec=Delta_m E_Rd[ln(MP/(ab))/(d-1)]. Neither spectral conditioning nor reference normalization implies Boolean marginal admission at inherited physical biases: an actual biased two-bit OR at p=q=1/4 yields non-Boolean marginal (0,1), and fair AND4 split 2+2 yields marginals (0,1/3,1/3,1/3) and non-Boolean Q0 uniform on nine mixed labels. Conversely an explicit four-bit Boolean sign (2X0-1)(2X2-1)(-1)^(X1 X3) has Boolean joint product spectrum with both marginals (0,1/2,0,1/2) non-Boolean. At arbitrary interior product biases a normalized joint product law has a Boolean realization with separable real coefficient signs iff both marginal laws have Boolean realizations in their inherited bases. An actual five-bit two-weight threshold supplies a strictly negative rational interval certificate for KL(Rd||Qd)-TC_spec. Deterministic coordinates must contract and reused physical variables must be substituted before the normalized product transform. No absolute bound on the mixed logarithmic expectation or universal FEI is asserted.
